text.formatted:
You have resistance to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gem in the ring indicates the type, which the GM chooses or determines randomly.

|   d10 | Damage Type   | Gem        |
|-------|---------------|------------|
|     1 | Acid          | Pearl      |
|     2 | Cold          | Tourmaline |
|     3 | Fire          | Garnet     |
|     4 | Force         | Sapphire   |
|     5 | Lightning     | Citrine    |
|     6 | Necrotic      | Jet        |
|     7 | Poison        | Amethyst   |
|     8 | Psychic       | Jade       |
|     9 | Radiant       | Topaz      |
|    10 | Thunder       | Spinel     |
